protocol.prompt_split: floor(20% of sorted prompts), default_rng(100+seed).choice without replacement; sorted remaining prompts train
protocol.cell_split: independent Bernoulli 30% vector of observed cells only; default_rng(seed)
protocol.vectorizer: TF-IDF word unigrams and bigrams; Q2 fits vocabulary on all prompts to match attached reference's transductive method; Q2_strict and primary risk fit training prompts only
protocol.neighbours: cosine top 5; reference default argsort, strict stable training-order ties; arithmetic mean of item parameters and both-bad rates; zero-similarity neighbours included
protocol.cell_weighting: one per observed cell; not weighted by vote count
protocol.both_bad_preregistration_status: PREREG and attached results do not specify a both-bad AUC experiment or binary target; exact claimed AUC reproduction is unverifiable
protocol.both_bad_vote_target: unregistered extension: each held-out human vote is 1 exactly when vote_type is bothbad_vote; all votes for one held-out prompt receive its text-only training-neighbour score
protocol.both_bad_prompt_target: unregistered extension: held-out prompt has at least one both-bad human vote; no threshold tuning
protocol.length_baseline: negative character count; sign fixed from supplied short-prompt risk hypothesis; no fitted threshold
protocol.q4_missing_outcomes: reference method: IRT chooses highest-scored model among models observed for each held-out prompt; baseline chooses global model mean winner when observed, otherwise highest training mean among available models
protocol.q4_paired_extension: stricter unregistered diagnostic: evaluate only prompts with observed outcomes for BOTH fixed global recommendations; unavailable outcomes excluded and counted
protocol.q4_interpretation: Positive available-choice gains can arise from different global model orderings plus missing outcomes; they do not demonstrate prompt-specific routing or measured money saved
protocol.historical_scope: both-bad rate is a relative pairwise-vote statistic, not a calibrated per-generation failure probability
protocol.method_correction: Initial diagnostic preserved separately. Audited reference constants supplied by independent code reviewer: ability L2=1, difficulty L2=.1, discrimination shrinkage to 1 L2=1; seed-dependent Gaussian initialization; splits corrected before final run. No metric thresholds changed.
protocol.penalty_preregistration_difference: PREREG names L2 on ability/difficulty but omits strengths and discrimination penalty; discrimination shrinkage is present in supplied reference and is declared here as an undeclared method detail
protocol.solver_difference: Fresh analytic-gradient L-BFGS-B bounds a directly rather than reference's clipping within an unconstrained objective; close metrics expected, exact floating equality not claimed

Q3.positive_discrimination_implication: Every prompt has the same ability ordering because every discrimination is positive; no prompt-specific model routing

both_bad_risk.exact_handoff_reproduction: UNVERIFIABLE: binary target and aggregation omitted from supplied preregistration/results

V4.reason: Both-bad target and aggregation are absent from the supplied preregistration/results. IRT constants follow the audited reference; direct bounded optimization is a documented solver difference.
